let { missing = true }: {missing?: boolean} = {};
const notNarrowed: true = missing;
let [defined = true]: [boolean?] = [false];
const notFalse: false = defined;
let { assigned = true }: {assigned?: boolean} = {assigned: false};
const alsoNotFalse: false = assigned;
function wrongDefault({ flag = false }: {flag?: true}) { const valid: true = flag; }
function includesUndefined({ flag = undefined }: {flag?: true}) { const invalid: true = flag; }
let { widened = 2 } = {} as {widened?: 1};
const invalidUnit: 1 | 2 = widened;
let { different = 'a' } = {different: 'b' as const};
const invalidText: 'a' | 'b' = different;
function generic<K extends 'active'>(key: K) {
  let {[key]: value = true}: {active?: boolean} = {active: undefined};
  const unresolved: true = value;
}
function union(key: 'a' | 'b') {
  let {[key]: value = true}: {a?: boolean; b?: boolean} = {a: undefined, b: undefined};
  const unresolved: true = value;
}
